links.outcome: Readability grade level of LLM thunderstorm asthma responses versus sixth-grade standard
links.effect: All LLM-generated responses were too complex for the general public and failed the sixth-grade reading standard; most outputs were at secondary education level or higher.
links.quote: However, all programme-generated informational responses were excessively complex for the general public, failing to meet sixth-grade reading comprehension standards, as the majority of outputs were written at a secondary education level or higher.

links.outcome: Plain-language comprehensibility of AI-generated health information
links.effect: None of the LLMs met the recommended sixth-grade readability benchmark; outputs were mostly at secondary education level or higher.
links.quote: This study reveals that while LLM demonstrate some reliability in handling complex health consultations, none meet the recommended readability benchmark for a sixth-grade reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability and reliability of LLM outputs (ChatGPT-4, DeepSeek, Perplexity, Copilot) for patient-facing health information queries on thunderstorm asthma, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
